en: The image is a black-and-white photograph depicting a street or pathway bordered by fences and lined with utility poles. On the left is a large, leafy tree in front of a stone wall with an arched gate. The architectural style, fortified walls, and large building in the background suggest a historical site, possibly a fortress or barracks. Several people in early 20th-century dress are walking along the path.
